name: system-health
summary: Score a system in use across coverage, adoption, accessibility, drift and documentation, and say which single number to move next.

when: someone asks how the design system is doing
a quarterly or periodic check is due
a system needs a baseline before investment

steps: Measure five things and refuse to estimate any of them: component coverage, adoption, accessibility, drift, and documentation coverage.
Every number is a count with a denominator. '80% adopted' with no denominator is a feeling.
Compare against the last run if there is one. A single reading says almost nothing; a trend says whether the investment is working.
Name ONE number to move next, with the reason. A dashboard where everything is a priority sets no priority.
output: The scored dimensions with counts and denominators, the trend if available, and the one number to move.
done: every score is a measured count over a stated denominator
no number was reasoned rather than counted
exactly one next priority is named
